_about: Generic evaluation: metadata, facts, table cells, comparisons, summaries and questions the document cannot answer, over three documents with different layouts. Expected strings were checked against each document's extracted text, not written from memory. Scoring: every string in `all` must appear in the answer, and at least one string from each group in `any` (case-insensitive, thousands separators ignored). `abstain` questions pass when the answer says the document does not contain the information.

lightrag.layout: single-column academic paper (ICLR style), multi-level win-rate tables

bert.layout: two-column academic paper (ACL style), bold body-size headings, stacked table headers

nist.layout: 48-page government framework report, cover pages, table of contents, text tables
